Author: Ajay Bhanot
Bench: Ajay Bhanot

HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD ?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:AHC:5878 Court No. - 64 Case :- CRIMINAL MISC. BAIL APPLICATION No. - 30887 of 2023 Applicant :- Rahul Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Counsel for Applicant :- Chandra Bir Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Anjali Jaiswal,Dhirendra Kumar Verma Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.

By means of the the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No. 240 of 2020 at Police Station- Etmadpur, District- Agra under Sections 498A, 304-B, 302, 34 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
The applicant is in jail since 09.10.2020.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 05.05.2023.

The following arguments made by Shri Chandra Bir Singh, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant, which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Sri Paritosh Kumar Malviya, learned AGA-I from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
1.
The applicant is the husband of the deceased.

Rahul vs State Of U.P. on 11 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86157919/
1
2. The applicant never harassed the deceased nor did he demand dowry.
3. The deceased had a love interest.
She was forced by her parents to marry the applicant.
The deceased became depressed on account of failure of her relationship with her love interest to materialize into marriage.
4. On the fateful day she succumbed to depression and took the extreme step of ending her life.
She committed suicide by hanging.
5. The postmortem report opines the cause of death as asphyxia due to antemortem hanging.

6. Injuries depicted in the postmortem report consistent with hanging are:
(i) Nature of ligature mark.
(ii).
The hyoid bone was intact.
7. The applicant did not aid or abet the suicide.
8. Prosecution evidence do not connect the applicant with the offence.
9. The prerequisites for attracting the presumption and the reversing the burden of proof are not established in the facts and circumstances and evidence of the case.
10. The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from the instant case.
11. The applicant is not flight risk.
The applicant being law abiding citizen have always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to join the trial proceedings.
There is no possibility of their influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant- Rahul be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
